_authority: Drafted from Ultimate Bible v5 engines + Drive voice samples (2026-07-17). ALL CANDIDATE until Julian signs each card. ElevenLabs IDs empty until voices are created/cast in his account; the Drive mp3s are the reference targets.
_rights_flag: Asset register lists voice rights as 'to confirm'. Before any sample is cloned or any voice ships externally: confirm each mp3's origin (AI-designed vs recorded performer) and its usage rights. Cloning a recorded performer requires their written consent.

Narrator.cadence: storybook-warm, unhurried, a reader by lamplight; carries the ache gently and never announces the lesson
Narrator.register: opens and closes episodes; never intrudes on scenes

Richard.cadence: warm Cardiff rhythm, low and unhurried; thinks with his hands while he talks; goes QUIETER when something matters, never louder; wisdom arrives as questions
Richard.welsh_texture: hiraeth and cariad, naturally placed, never translated on screen
delivery_laws: the pauses carry as much as the words

settings_hint._note: steady, low-drama read — tune on first audition

Lily.cadence: quick, certain, front-footed; decisions sound like they were made three seconds ago; softens only when someone is genuinely hurt
delivery_laws: doubt shows in tempo, not in words

Albert.cadence: precise, slightly formal for a twelve-year-old; quotes his own notebook; speeds up when he's connecting evidence, stalls completely when feelings are required
Albert.welsh_texture: diolch, correctly and a little carefully
delivery_laws: his wonder escapes despite him — one breath late

Rose.cadence: soft attack, listening even while speaking; asks the question underneath the question; when she names a feeling the room goes still
Rose.welsh_texture: cariad, quietly, to people who are hurting — including people from 1780
delivery_laws: her certainty is gentle but absolute

Peggi.cadence: blurts at full speed, zero filter, delight and outrage both arrive at maximum; the youngest voice in the room and the first to say the true thing
Peggi.welsh_texture: bendigedig! as her superlative for everything good
delivery_laws: the forbidden question is asked plainly
comedy from sincerity, never from mugging

supporting_ep1._note: The Wrong Tune guest cast (Burgundy 1867). Cadence cards drafted when the episode script is broken down; IDs cast by Julian.

workflow: Per character: audition the Drive sample against the card → create/cast the ElevenLabs voice (design-from-spec, or clone ONLY with confirmed rights) → paste voice ID + tuned settings here → card locks on Julian's sign-off. Same lifecycle as Crystal Bears voice_cards.json.
